expanded_title: Amy vs. JB in a $10.4K Pot: No Backing Down on the $5/$10/$25 Felt at Champions Social Club Dallas
expanded_deck: Locked in during Hand 47 of the $5/$10/$25 cash-game broadcast at Champions Social Club in Dallas, Amy H goes head-to-head with JB in a $10,400 pot.
expanded_body:
Originally posted October 10, 2026.

Amy vs. JB for a $10,400 pot — no backing down at Champions Social Club in Dallas!

On Hand 47 of the $5/$10/$25 No-Limit Hold'em feature broadcast at Champions Social Club (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1398989519959467/), Amy H ($5.2K in the small blind, sporting her Dallas Stars cap with arms crossed and completely locked in) squared off against JB with a $10.4K pot on the line at a table featuring Spooky ($6.9K in the cutoff), Scott L ($5.9K in the big blind), and Scott H ($4.3K on the button).

Watch the full $10,400 confrontation on Facebook.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
